svg.text: Casino Open Sign V2 - layout (front view, 60 x 30 cm plate, to scale)
2 strips (12 V WS2811, 1 pixel = 1 chip = 3 LEDs = 10 cm): frame 18 pixels on D11, letters 10 pixels on D12; + 11 Grove sticks (10 arrow + CLOSED).
Positions are indicative (letter and arrow positions are your choice); the pixel numbers and the wiring order are exact.
strip pixels 7-10 run right to left: OPEN is wired REVERSED (the program maps the letters)
arrow 35.0 x 10.2 cm (sticks at real size; names as in wiring-diagram)
Frame animation (a bar of 2 lit pixels, 2 dark, repeating, runs both ways round the frame, 9 steps, meets at the end corner):
arrow points LEFT (customer's left): starts at the UPPER-RIGHT corner (pixel 10), runs clockwise (10, 9, 8, 7, 6 ...) and counter-clockwise (10, 11 ... 15, 16-18)
arrow points RIGHT (customer's right): starts at the UPPER-LEFT corner (pixel 15), runs both ways to the LOWER-RIGHT corner (pixel 6).
Strip: pixel 1 in the lower-left corner, counter-clockwise (dot = DIN end). Dashed grey line in the letters = data jumper in strip order. Front view.
Letters: CASINO = pixels 1-6, OPEN = pixels 10, 9, 8, 7 (O P E N). Dashed boxes: the plexiglass letters; the pixel sits behind each letter.
